description: Return v3 dataflow risks over the function graph. Includes legacy direct/propagated taint projections plus bridge-helper risks where a wrapper calls both a source reader and a dangerous sink.

include_broad_file_io.description: Include broad readFile/writeFile-style default risks. Default false.

include_generated.description: Include default risks that touch generated/codegen files. Default false.

include_tests.description: Include dataflow risks that touch test files. Default false.

max_risks.description: Maximum risks to return. Default 50, max 500.

max_tokens.description: Cap the response to roughly this many tokens.

sinks.description: Additional sink names to merge with defaults and .projscanrc taint.sinks.

sources.description: Additional source names to merge with defaults and .projscanrc taint.sources.

name: projscan_dataflow
